# MarketForge TikTok Organic

Apply V3 §3.7.

## Global quality rules

- **B2C:** unmatched for sub-$100 AOV DTC, creator, mobile apps.
- **B2B:** working for accessible categories (no-code, AI tools, marketing, sales).
- Native UGC > polished brand content.
- Sub-30-second hooks; talking-head on a couch format.
- Cost is creative ops, not media (for organic).
- AI-generated TikTok faces are detected; founder/customer/employee real faces win.

## Purpose

1. Fit check.
2. Content type mix (UGC, talking-head, behind-the-scenes, trend-jacking).
3. Cadence (3-7 posts/week typical).
4. Voice / persona.
5. Creator collaboration strategy.

## Inputs
- `channel-strategy.md`, `brand-strategy.md`, `icp-and-personas/`.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/07-organic-social/tiktok-organic.md`
- DEC-434 to DEC-439

## Structure

```markdown
# TikTok Organic Strategy

## Fit check
- ICP active on TikTok: [evidence — search relevant hashtags, find ICP-relevant accounts]
- Product visually demonstrable: [yes/no]
- Founder / team comfortable on camera: [yes/no]

## Content types

### Native UGC
- Founder / team on camera.
- Customer-style (with permission).
- "Day in the life" / behind-the-scenes.

### Talking-head (on couch / desk)
- POV / insight in 15-30 sec.
- Single takeaway per video.

### Trend-jack
- Use trending sound / format.
- Apply to your category angle.
- Speed matters (trends die in 2-7 days).

### Product demo
- Screen recording with voiceover.
- Specific use case in 30-60 sec.

## Hook patterns
- "Stop doing [X]." (instructional contrarian)
- "If you're a [ICP role], you need to know..." (audience-targeted)
- "I [specific action] for [N days/weeks]. Here's what happened." (results-led)
- Specific number opener.

## Cadence
- 3-7 posts/week.
- 1 trend-jack/week (when relevant trend present).
- Reply to every comment in first 60-90 min.

## Voice
- Conversational.
- Specific.
- No corporate sheen.
- First-person.

## Repurposing
- TikTok original → IG Reels → YouTube Shorts → LinkedIn (when relevant) → X (with snippet).

## KPIs
- Follower growth.
- View-through rate on top videos.
- DM-driven inbound.
- App installs / signups (via UTM + self-report).

## Decision cards
[DEC-434 to DEC-439]

## Kill criteria
- 3-6 months; follower growth flat + no signup signal + no virality moments → re-evaluate.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- AI-generated faces.
- Buying followers.
- Brand-cadence over-polished content (anti-pattern for TikTok).

## Sources and basis
V3 §3.7.
```
